# Urgent Repair Request for Leaking Kitchen Ceiling

A professional, polite note that clearly states the problem, the timeline, and the need for written confirmation.

## Email Draft

**Subject:** Urgent Repair Request: Leaking Kitchen Ceiling

Dear [Landlord’s Name],

I hope you are well. I am writing to follow up on the leaking kitchen ceiling in my 1-bedroom apartment in Toronto. I first reported this issue by text, and the leak has now been ongoing for 10 days.

Because the leak has not yet been repaired, I am concerned about further damage to the ceiling and surrounding areas. I would appreciate it if this could be addressed as soon as possible.

Please confirm in writing that the repair will be arranged by **[insert deadline date and time]**. If you need access to the unit, please let me know what time works best and I will do my best to accommodate.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter. I look forward to your written confirmation.

Sincerely,
[Your Full Name]
[Unit Number]
[Phone Number]
